title: Style Templates on Lightning Maps (Beta)
summary: Org-level map style templates: where the entry points live, how an ArcGIS-sourced layer differs from a templated one, the attribute → style → options editor modelled on Esri's Styles pane, status-based icon colouring and a switchable icon library.
notes: Left panel scrolls; the map does not. Wheel / drag / double-click / arrow keys all zoom and pan.
Layer card “…” → Style Layer opens the editor in the panel, so the map stays live.
Mock controls dock at the bottom right toggles icon library, colour mode, the feature flag and the dark basemap.
Icon glyphs are stand-ins drawn for the mock, not licensed Calcite/SLDS/FontAwesome/Maki assets.
